plan.title: Workflow redesign D1: conversation header (Changes and Files buttons, ⋯ menu) and status line in words
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One header component and its status line, split into 11 small items that mostly share ConversationHeader.tsx/ConversationHeaderMenu.tsx; the file count is driven by one test file per new module, two existing Playwright specs that click the moved Tools button, two screenshots and three doc files. The parent PRD (PAN-5284 §9-§10) already fixes D1 as one child issue; splitting further would leave the dashboard with a half-moved header (parent D-13).

narratives.Problem: From a conversation tab there is no way to see what the agent changed or to browse its files, and the header is crowded with About, Tools, Bookmarks, Copy link and Detach buttons while the status line shows a raw session id and an editor chip. ConversationPanel.tsx is 1525 lines against a 1531 cap, so nothing can be added without extracting first.
narratives.Proposal: Extract the header into components/chat/header/ (ConversationHeader, ConversationHeaderMenu, ConversationStatusLine) with no behavior change. Then add Changes (+/-) and Files buttons that open the work dock scoped to the conversation, fed by the dock's own useConversationChanges query (scope 'conversation') and mounted only inside a Stage. Move About, Bookmarks, Show tool calls, Copy link, Open in new window, Copy conversation id, Copy session id, Open folder in <Editor>, Subagents and an Advanced group (delivery transport) into the ⋯ menu in the mockup's order. Rewrite the status line in words: state · machine · ~/folder (opens Files) · branch (+PR badge) · N commits pushed / not pushed (open Changes) · N files not committed (opens Changes on Not committed, amber) · cost (cyan). Fix the dock Changes chip so a repeat openDock with a changesScope switches it. Update the two Playwright specs that clicked the Tools button, add a fixture-backed header spec with light/dark screenshots, and update features/conversations.mdx, docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md and changelog.d/pan-5291.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the per-turn Changed files card, ChangedFilesTree.tsx, the inline DiffPanel / ?diff=1 path or the 5 s /diffs poll (child D2).
- No change to ComposerFooter.tsx, DeliveryModeSelect.tsx, EffortPicker.tsx, PaneBar.tsx or the Stage tab labels (child D2).
- The subagents rail's default open/closed state does not change (child D2 WI-D6); only a toggle signal is added.
- No server or API change; GET /api/conversations/:name/changes is used as child A shipped it.
- No confirm dialog is added to Stop the agent.
- No Changes/Files buttons and no commit/uncommitted status-line parts outside a Stage (popout, phone app, drawer, Flywheel pane, Agents directory).
- No change to conversation list rows or their change totals (child F).
- No new polling loop and no polling faster than 5 s.
- No scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt edit; ConversationPanel.tsx never grows past 1525 lines.
- The aria-label "More conversation actions" on the ⋯ trigger is not renamed.
- PanOpenInPicker keeps its behavior for its other consumers (IssueOpenInDialog, IssueDetailSections).

autoDecisions.summary: D1 ships the ⋯ → Subagents item through a new SubagentRail toggleSignal prop; D2 keeps owning the rail's default state.
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-1 (assigned to D1) lists Subagents in ⋯ while parent §7 gives the rail default to D2; a one-prop seam satisfies FR-1 without changing the default D2 owns.

autoDecisions.summary: Copy conversation id copies conversation.name; a separate Copy session id item keeps the old status-line session-file id reachable when it differs.
autoDecisions.rationale: The mockup shows the name; parent §7 (no-loss) requires today's session id value to stay reachable.

autoDecisions.summary: Changes/Files buttons and the commit/uncommitted status-line parts render only inside a Stage (useStageDeck().openDock exists); outside they are absent.
autoDecisions.rationale: There is no dock to open outside a Stage; parent FR-4 keeps today's behavior outside a Stage, and gating keeps /changes and the root-context queries out of 12 mount sites and their strict-fetch tests.

autoDecisions.summary: The header's /changes query is enabled only for real rows (id >= 0) that are not linked or vault conversations, and reuses the dock's query key.
autoDecisions.rationale: Synthetic ids 404 (same guard as /diffs); linked and vault rows have no local root; sharing the key means one request for header, Files dots and Changes tab.

autoDecisions.summary: Open folder in… is a flat list of editor menu items (preferred first; remote SSH list for linked conversations), and the header keeps calling useEditorOpenFavoriteShortcut.
autoDecisions.rationale: MenuSurface has no submenus; the ⌘⇧O shortcut was mounted by the status-line picker and would otherwise disappear.

autoDecisions.summary: The folder text uses a textual home abbreviation (/home/<u>, /Users/<u>, /root → ~).
autoDecisions.rationale: The frontend has no home directory value for a conversation; the rule is deterministic and testable.

autoDecisions.summary: Status-line colors follow the mockup: amber for 'N files not committed', cyan for cost, the existing state dot; everything else muted.
autoDecisions.rationale: Parent D-1 makes the mockup the visual spec; each color keeps its style-guide meaning, and the one-signal-per-row rule targets data-dense list rows, not this header line.

autoDecisions.summary: Header Changes and Files buttons always open the dock (never toggle) and always pass changesScope.
autoDecisions.rationale: Predictable behavior from a labelled button; the shortcuts keep toggling; passing the scope lets the chip reset (D1-15).

autoDecisions.summary: 'Stop agent' in the header menu is renamed 'Stop the agent' without adding the mockup's confirm ellipsis.
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-1 names it 'Stop the agent'; today's action has no dialog and adding one is out of scope.

autoDecisions.summary: The changelog file is changelog.d/pan-5291.md, not the stub's 5291.md.
autoDecisions.rationale: changelog.d/README.md requires the lowercase issue id and every sibling child uses pan-<n>.md.
